answer: Like a living wharf rooted in roiling tides, our decentralized consensus anchors identity to reciprocal trust webs. When an adversary spawns a hollow plume of synthetic clones, peer-bonding algorithms impose a superlinear staking cost that penalizes clustered collusions. Trust crystallizes organically: each spurious link demands exponentially higher collateral, drowning counterfeit swarms before they breach the economic harbor.
